name: Burpee Box Jump
steps: Face a stable box with feet shoulder-width apart and enough clear space to lower your chest to the floor.
Drop down into a burpee by placing your hands on the floor, kicking back to lower your chest down, and snapping your feet back forward.
Rise smoothly out of the crouch, swing your arms, and leap explosively with both feet onto the center of the box.
Land softly with bent knees, stand tall on top, and step down carefully one foot at a time into the next repetition.
tips: Step down carefully between repetitions instead of jumping backward off the box under fatigue.
Land softly with both whole feet planted firmly on top of the box before extending your hips.
